parse_notes: Closed local observations on frozen synthetic benches. No generated answer, prompt, answer key, weight or machine log is published; no role is adopted.

Ornith-1.5-122B (ornith-ai), GGUF AD-IQ4_XS-IQ3_S mixed (AtomicChat, third-party conversion), on ONE RTX 3090 FE: all 49 layers (and the output layer) on GPU, with the MoE experts of the first 34 layers kept in system RAM (--n-cpu-moe 34, 39.5 GiB of weights mapped on the CPU), 16,384-token context, one llama.cpp slot, so the eight requests of the house protocol are served one after another.

Same weights and image as ornith-1.5-122b-pair, the conditional arm on the other topology. Single stream 15.6 tok/s against 29.1 for ornith-1.5-122b-pair, aggregate 15.6 against 29.0 (three passes each, one slot): about 46.6 % slower single stream than the main record, in all three passes.
The predeclared fit search loaded at its first setting (12.0 s).

Picked from a public model watch, downloaded at a fixed revision and checked by SHA-256, with its arms written and its fit searched before they ran; the conditional arm on the other topology ran after this model's planned arms had finished.

Run on 21 October (06:08-08:18 UTC) in a day window opened after night 5 with the owner's go-ahead, under the night's campaign, image and launch lines; the night window had ended with no arm of this model run.
